name: content-brief
title: Content review brief
for_each: select id,name from documents where not archived

sections.title: Revision record
sections.sql: select revision,actor,note,created_at from revisions where document_id=$1 order by revision

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: select revision,decision,actor,evidence,created_at from approvals where document_id=$1 order by created_at

name: retention-review
title: Personal content retention review
for_each: select id,name from documents where privacy='personal'

sections.title: Local bundle, not deployed
sections.sql: select name,sha256,actor,created_at from bundles where id=$1

sections.title: Included documents
sections.sql: select x->>'id' document_id,x->>'revision' revision,x->'document'->>'_id' source_id,x->'document'->>'_type' content_type from bundles,jsonb_array_elements(snapshot) x where id=$1
